## 3. Detailed Verification Findings

### 3.1 Raw Datasets Integrity (Test 3)
- All 7 Kaggle raw CSV files (`train.csv`, `test.csv`, `stores.csv`, `oil.csv`, `holidays_events.csv`, `transactions.csv`, `sample_submission.csv`) match their expected byte-size and line-count signatures.
- Zero modifications were made to the original files in `datasets/raw/`.

### 3.2 Data Leakage & Shift-1 Guarantees (Tests 8, 9, 10)
- **Lag Integrity:** Grouping by `(store_nbr, family)` strictly isolates time series across all 54 stores and 33 product families. Lags from Store A never contaminate Store B.
- **Shift-1 Guarantee:** Rolling statistics (`rolling_mean_7`, `rolling_std_7`, `rolling_mean_14`, `rolling_mean_28`) mathematically match the strictly shifted historical window $t-k \dots t-1$. Current-day sales $t$ is strictly excluded.
- **Target Isolation:** Target variables (`sales`, `log1p_sales`) are completely absent from `test_features.csv`.
- **Concurrent Leakage Prevention:** Concurrent transactions (foot-traffic) are excluded from predictive features, preventing test-time lookahead failure.

### 3.3 Join Stability & Idempotence (Tests 11, 12)
- Transferred holidays and multi-event dates were mapped through store geography (National to all stores, Regional to state, Local to city), preventing duplicate records.
- Repeated execution of `preprocess_dataset.py` produces bit-for-bit identical SHA-256 hashes.

### 3.4 Core Application & Backend Isolation (Test 13)
- `backend/main.py`, FastAPI routes, Pydantic schemas, and SQLAlchemy database models remain 100% untouched.
- Both SQLite databases (`shoppulse.db`, `shoppulse_dev.db`) and Firebase configurations are completely intact.
